changelog:
- Initial release of CashClaw WhatsApp Manager.
- Enables setup and management of WhatsApp Business accounts, including auto-response systems, greeting/away messages, and FAQ/quick-reply templates.
- Supports broadcast campaign creation with audience targeting, scheduling, and compliance rules.
- Provides client-ready workflows and templates for efficient communication automation.
- Includes clear pricing and delivery timelines for core services.
summary: Sets up and manages WhatsApp Business accounts including auto-response systems, client communication workflows, FAQ templates, and broadcast campaigns.
